nodes.label: Case Detail Modal – Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a case/record detail modal in the Captio Spanish-language interface. The modal is titled 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' with the breadcrumb 'Negocios / contrato'. It shows a status workflow bar with states: Invitado, Nuevo, En revisión (currently active/selected), Consulta agendada, Revisión de conflicto, Cliente aceptado ✓, Rechazado, Cerrado. Action buttons include Editar, Respuestas del cliente, Descargar HTML, and Eliminar. The document body shows a generated legal case summary with: Fecha de ingesta (intake date) as placeholder, Clasificación: Contrato de servicios — Incumplimiento y defectos en implementación de sistema ERP. Key points (PUNTOS CLAVE) include: ERP implementation contract for $1.8M MXN with NovaSoft Sistemas S.A. de C.V., client paid $1.08M MXN advance in March 2024; system delivered with 47 documented incidents, 12 unresolved 5 months after agreed deadline (15 Sep 2024), actual delivery 30 Sep 2024; quantified damages: $2.4M MXN in cancelled orders + $800k MXN in penalties from corporate clients for SLA breach; NovaSoft offers 20% discount on remaining balance, client rejects. A LÍNEA DE TIEMPO (timeline) section shows 'Cliente demo generado' event at 4/6/2026, 1:01:18 p.m. The screenshot captures the case management workflow, AI-generated legal document preview, and demo data for the Captio legal/contract dispute platform.
